title: Protected original-document access from case evidence and citations
scope: Connect evidence metadata and citations to the authorized original through Frappe or the verified native OpenAleph viewer without copying an entire document UI.

acceptance.text: From case evidence and a finding citation, an authorized officer opens the correct immutable document/version and page or record where supported; otherwise visibly identify the locator without pretending page navigation occurred.

Enforce tenant/case permission at content retrieval, protect direct URLs and avoid public originals, credential URLs or unrestricted previews; unavailable content, denied access and extraction failures are distinct states.
Run synthetic success and cross-tenant/case-denial tests, verify fingerprint/version against the original and capture viewport/keyboard/accessibility evidence.
Record tests and limitations, update evidence and open a PR; do not claim native runtime readiness from fixtures.

verification: Authenticated synthetic native-screen and connected navigation checks; denied access, unavailable service and documented human visual review.
notes: Added by TAX-105 from user-requested complete frontend/native UI scope; not implemented or claimed.
